meta.scope: Physical marked workbook/test upload to longitudinal diagnosis and remediation

pipeline.name: Quality validation
pipeline.rule: Low-quality pages must be flagged before academic diagnosis.

pipeline.name: Content extraction
pipeline.rule: Store extracted text with confidence and source coordinates; never overwrite original image evidence.

pipeline.name: Interpret teacher marking
pipeline.rule: Teacher mark has priority for correctness when clearly readable. AI must not silently override it.

pipeline.name: Attribute observed error
pipeline.rule: A wrong answer is evidence, not automatically a confirmed weakness.

human_review_gates: essay root-cause attribution with insufficient evidence
oral skill inference attempted from written evidence
non_negotiable_rules: Never treat OCR uncertainty as learner error.
Never infer weak prerequisite when evidence is merely absent; use UNKNOWN.
Never diagnose from total paper score alone.
Store question-level evidence so every diagnosis is auditable.
Allow teacher correction of transcription, mapping and diagnosis.
Recalculate downstream mastery when teacher corrects evidence.
